1879064187.name: Raise the Spirit
1879064187.desc: Quickly heals Morale of an ally or yourself.

1879073019.name: Brutal Strikes
1879073019.desc: Makes three deadly attacks that are difficult to parry or evade.

1879136251.name: Point-defence
1879136251.desc: You place a banner bearing the symbol of the hardened new breed of Uruk, the White Hand. All who stand near the banner the banner draw defensive strength from the symbol.

1879157627.name: Blood-seeker
1879157627.desc: An AOE attack that leaves a DoT.

1879182843.name: Rune-sign of Winter
1879182843.desc: A heal-over-time that always applies the Frost Armour passive buff\n \n Requires Healing Attunement.

1879198331.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Tundra Lynx)
1879198331.desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879214587.name: Power Attack
1879214587.desc: A powerful weapon blow which deals damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879215867.name: Song-brother
1879215867.desc: A toggle marking an ally as your Song-brother, making them the target of some of your abilities.

1879219451.name: Improved Prelude to Hope
1879219451.desc: Stories of great triumph begin with such preludes. Restores power as well if your ally has Writ of Health active.  +2% healing per Healing attunement.

1879221499.name: Autumnfest Horse
1879221499.desc: A horse from the Fall Festival.

1879222139.name: Enhanced Battle Acuity
1879222139.desc: You make a cunning attack that catches your opponents off-guard. Your area-of-effect attacks will deal even more damage for a short time.

1879233275.name: Essence of Flame
1879233275.desc: AoE fire attack that refreshes Fiery Ridicule on the target.

1879248379.name: Noble Arrow - Light
1879248379.desc: The Noble Arrow of Light, once launched, will seek to injure your foe with critical intent.

1879268475.name: Stomp!
1879268475.desc: Núrzum raises his leg and prepares to crush the nearest foe!

1879272827.name: Improved Sure Strike
1879272827.desc: An attack that cannot be blocked or parried.\n\nReduces the active cooldown of Battle-shout.

1879274107.name: Snap Shot - Ambush
1879274107.desc: When given time to prepare, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879316219.name: Well-travelled Turtle
1879316219.desc: Summons a well-travelled turtle to your side. It has seen far more of Middle-earth than you would expect of a turtle. Now it travels with you!

1879319931.name: Trample
1879319931.desc: Your steed is able to barrel over unmounted foes dealing massive damage.

1879341435.name: Winter's Wind
1879341435.desc: Brings out a winter's wind kite for you to fly!

1879386107.name: Goat of Ered Mithrin
1879386107.desc: A goat inspired by the stalwart beauty of the Grey Mountains.

1879449851.name: Rending Blow (Dual)
1879449851.desc: You strike your opponent across the face with your paw, interrupting their action.

1879467259.name: Ragged Knife
1879467259.desc: A chipped and rusted throwing knife.

1879470587.name: Wounding Knife
1879470587.desc: Throw a serrated throwing knife, honed to a razer-sharp edge.

1879489147.name: Shielding Roots
1879489147.desc: Your companion wraps themself in a casement of roots and vines, shielding them from harm.

1879506555.name: Prepare: Shadow Breath
1879506555.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, you breathe a gout of living shadow potentially instilling fear in your enemies.

1879506683.name: Strength
1879506683.desc: Strike your enemy with the certainty and strength of an Ent.

1879508603.name: Pitch-dark Scorpion
1879508603.desc: Summons a pitch-dark scorpion to accompany you on your travels.

1879520635.name: Rusty Mûrai Herding Dog
1879520635.desc: Summons a hard working herding dog to accompany you on your travels.

1879523195.name: The Effigy of The High Sorcerer of Harad
1879523195.desc: Summon an effigy of The High Sorcerer of Harad, doomed to die shortly after it appears.

1879524091.name: Fury of the Warlord
1879524091.desc: A demonstration of raw strength that deals massive damage to your enemies and saps their morale afterward.

1879525371.name: Mighty Ram Fireworks
1879525371.desc: Unleash a mighty ram of fireworks!
